neighbours.label: the first piece of a split word naming an animal or creature: por|cupine, pang|olin, arm|adillo, wal|rus, Pap|agei; other split words stay quiet
fire: The deaths of seals and porpoises alarmed the biologists.
A porcupine and a pangolin were in the cage.
An armadillo crossed the road at dusk.
A walrus lay on the ice near the boat.
Children read about the platypus at school.
The hippo and the salamander live near water.
Das Tier ist ein Papagei aus Brasilien.
An iguana sat on the warm rock.
quiet: The deaths of sailors and fishermen alarmed the villagers.
A papaya and a pear were in the bowl.
An armchair stood by the door at dusk.
A blanket lay on the ice near the boat.
Children read about the igloo at school.
The salami and the bread stay near the fridge.
Das Obst ist eine Papaya aus Brasilien.
A bangle sat on the warm rock.

short: first piece of a creature's name
notes: The fire and near-miss items include the same first pieces in some cases (' Pap', ' arm', ' sal'), on purpose: it shows whether the piece alone is enough. The card also shows ' hip' in 'hippie' and ' Hob' in 'Hobgoblin'.
